title: Hard Negative Mining for Domain-Specific Retrieval in Enterprise Systems
authors: Hansa Meghwani; Amit Agarwal; Priyaranjan Pattnayak; Hitesh Laxmichand Patel; Srikant Panda
why_relevant: Proposes hard negative mining for reranker training, tangentially related to noisy retrieval since hard negatives are used to improve retriever discrimination against semantically similar but irrelevant documents.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on retriever/reranker training quality, not on RAG robustness, distraction, conflict, or calibration under unreliable evidence.
